tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The page ground: the black between structures. Text: text, text-muted, text-faint, signal, alarm.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Section grounds and the top bar. Text: text, text-muted, text-faint, signal, alarm.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: HUD panels, cards, the terminal body and dialogs. Text: text, text-muted, text-faint, signal, alarm.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: A raised or selected panel: the open member card, table header, toasts. Text: text, text-muted, text-faint.

tokens.name: panel-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items and ghost buttons. Text: text and text-muted.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the 8px depth-ruler minor ticks. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Panel edges, control outlines at rest, table rules. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The white HUD line: frame corners, reticles, ruler major ticks, the scale marker, the disabled control edge. Marks need 3:1 on void, ground and panel.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles on void, ground, panel, panel-raised, panel-hover, screen and alarm-dim.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Body text and secondary labels on void, ground, panel, panel-raised and panel-hover.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, depth numbers and the English line under a label, on void, ground, panel and panel-raised (4.8:1 at worst).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one light: current state, active nav, the primary button, focus, live readouts and the far light slit. Never a large fill: 3% of a screen at most. Text on void, ground, panel and screen.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Alias of signal for tools that need a primary colour.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of signal fills and signal text.

tokens.name: signal-dim
tokens.usage: Inactive ticks, the scanline sweep and the loading track. Decorative only.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (the primary button, the selected tab plate).

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: Monitor fill: a cyan-tinted panel for in-world screens (comms, terminal output). Text: text and signal.

tokens.name: screen-line
tokens.usage: The 3px scanlines on screen panels. Decorative only.

tokens.name: alarm
tokens.usage: Alarm only: the hostile-contact frame, the alarm banner edge, error text. Text on void, ground, panel and alarm-dim.

tokens.name: alarm-dim
tokens.usage: Alarm plate fill behind alarm text and the alarm banner ground. Text: text and alarm.

tokens.name: on-alarm
tokens.usage: Text on a solid alarm fill (the confirm-danger button).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Print paper: the ground of ink plates and the printed specimen card. Text: on-paper.

tokens.name: on-paper
tokens.usage: Ink on paper: text and rules on the paper ground.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline offset 2px, 3:1 on void, ground, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop and the dark slab behind type set over a plate.

families.sans: "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
families.wide: "Michroma", "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
families.data: "Chakra Petch", "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: The work's name, once, on the first screen; drawn compressed to 78% width (`.ms-compress`). 88px under 1200px wide, 64px on phones.

styles.name: display-depth
styles.usage: The giant depth numeral of a section (one per screen), in text-faint or line.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Section titles: thin, widely tracked, two to four characters. 28px on phones.

styles.name: title-block
styles.usage: Panel and card titles, member names, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy: one or two short sentences per paragraph, never more than three paragraphs a screen.
styles.sample: 结构只向下生长。没有人见过底。

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card text, table cells, toasts and terminal lines in CJK.
styles.sample: 信标在 03:12 恢复，持续 4 分钟。

styles.name: label
styles.usage: HUD labels and label plates (实况, 深度, 压力): thin, tracked, two to four characters.

styles.name: caps
styles.usage: The Latin line under a label or title: capitals only, 1-3 words. Latin-only face.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: HUD readouts: depth, pressure, distance, counters (tabular). Latin digits and units only.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Codes, timestamps, coordinates, ruler numbers and terminal prompts. Latin digits and symbols only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: label to caption, tick to number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The ruler step; icon to label; inside plates.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical) and list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones; card gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen padding (desktop side margin is 64px: space-16).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Desktop side margin and the gap above a section title.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every frame, plate, button and card: corners are square.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Status dots and the radio knob only.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: HUD lines, frame edges, rules.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Focus ring, selected edge, the alarm frame.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height (48px on phones).

tokens.name: corner
tokens.usage: Arm length of HUD frame corners.

tokens.name: tick
tokens.usage: Depth-ruler pitch: a minor tick every 8px, a major every 64px.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Width of the depth rail on the right edge (hidden on phones).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Button and field height (48px large).

tokens.name: scan-pitch
tokens.usage: Scanline pitch on screen panels (measured about 4px at 1920 on the reference monitors; 3px reads cleaner on text).

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press colour changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Tabs, toggles and panel swaps.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Line draw-on: frames and rules trace in from their corner.

tokens.name: dur-type
tokens.usage: Per-character print rate of terminal lines (a 40-character line takes 1.1s).

tokens.name: dur-blink
tokens.usage: Cursor and live-dot blink period (on 530 / off 530).

tokens.name: dur-scan
tokens.usage: One scanline sweep down a screen panel.

tokens.name: dur-alarm
tokens.usage: Alarm frame pulse period (on 440 / off 440): below 3 flashes a second.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Hover and panel swaps.

tokens.name: ease-trace
tokens.usage: Line draw-on.

tokens.name: ease-step
tokens.usage: Blink and alarm: hard on/off, no fade.
